zh-CN: 修复 Mac 更新缓存和启动确认，更新提示确认状态持久保存。
保护来源读取失败时的仓库记录，修复队列取消与自动化受理状态，改善分卷、引导和标签显示。
提供 DMG 与 .app ZIP；仅临时签名，未经 Apple 公证，资料保持兼容，请使用副本测试并保留备份。
en-US: Fix Mac update caching and startup confirmation, and persist update-notice acknowledgments.
Protect Warehouse records after source-read failures, fix queue cancellation and automation acceptance, and improve splitting, onboarding and tag display.
Provide DMG and .app ZIP; the app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, data remains compatible, and testing should use copies and independent backups.
